subject: How to make stan not print anything in the console while running?

messages.author: 3b679b7acf28007c
messages.subject: How to make stan not print anything in the console while running?
parts:
Hi,

Is there a way to have stan not printing anything on the console while running? 

I thought I could easily find it from stan package pdf but couldn't find. 

Thanks very much,
-Sepehr

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: How to make stan not print anything in the console while running?
parts:
On Monday, March 28, 2016 at 11:32:28 PM UTC-4, sepehr akhavan wrote:
Is there a way to have stan not printing anything on the console while running? 

I thought I could easily find it from stan package pdf but couldn't find.

If you are referring to the RStan package, you have to
sink(tempfile())
stan(...)
sink(NULL)

Ben

messages.author: 3b679b7acf28007c
messages.subject: Re: How to make stan not print anything in the console while running?
parts:

Is there anyway to hide all messages including warnings?

Thanks very much,
-Sepehr
